behavior: units.json U35f (the spec; not widened): the co-op host browser adopts the saved record's new version after a co-op update, so its next whole-envelope save is not refused (owner decision OD-u35d-server-and-host-fix, host half). designAnswers.whereTheHostFolds: CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.tsx:174-238, inside the host-only effect (:140-239). Each frame goes through campaignEventFromMessage (:197); foldCampaignFrame (:208) returns the fold unchanged by reference for a rejected frame, and only an accepted frame is projected onto the campaign store (:209-212). The refresh goes in that accepted branch, only for a CampaignEvent-kind frame (the kind the server gives every committed event that is not a snapshot, campaignEventWireFrame.ts:24-27, and the predicate the handler already uses for 'the server accepted a write', :190-193), so the hydration baseline a (re)connect sends (CampaignSnapshot kind, sequence -1) and a duplicate or stale frame do not read.
designAnswers.whatTheFrameCarries: { kind: 'CampaignEvent', matchId, ts, event } (Protocol.ts:955-961) with event.campaignId (campaignSyncSchemas.ts:176). refreshAfterCommittedCommand reads only ack.kind and ack.state.campaignId (useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts:1332-1338); receiptRevision and publicHead are optional and never read as a row version (:127-141). So { kind: 'committed', state: { campaignId: event.campaignId } } is buildable from the frame alone, with no server change and no edit under src/stores/campaign. The ack names the EVENT's campaign, not the surface's, so the store's own guard (:1332-1338) ignores a frame for any campaign other than the one it holds.
designAnswers.hostOnly: Yes. The fold and the refresh are in the effect that returns early unless coopMode === 'host' (:141). The guest's frames are handled by a separate effect (:241-305) that feeds the mirror store and is not changed.
designAnswers.whenTheReadFails: The store's existing handling, unchanged (useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts:1342-1356, runLoad :964-968): nothing is adopted, baseVersion stays at the pre-command token, saveState becomes error with the message, and when the store is dirty the debounced save is re-armed (:1352-1354). For a co-op host that re-arm is a save markDirty would never arm (:1382-1384); on a journal-native campaign it carries the pre-command token, so it answers 409 and rolls back with a toast (:832-846) - the same outcome as without U35f, two seconds later. Covered by the store's own rows (src/stores/campaign/__tests__/campaignCommandAckRefresh.test.ts:378-396, :456-479); this unit adds no failure handling.
designAnswers.raceOrLoop: No loop: the refresh only reads (GET, :701-705); runLoad's replacement of the live campaign (:942) marks the store dirty through the wiring (campaignPersistenceWiring.ts:104-117) but arms nothing for a co-op campaign (:1382-1384); the host effect's deps (:239) do not include the campaign object, so no reconnect; a read produces no frame. Races: (1) a save started while the read is in flight waits for it (runSave :790-792 awaits the published inFlightLoad, :1359). (2) A save already in flight is not awaited by the read (runLoad does not wait on the save chain), so the PUT's applySavedRecord (:816) and the read's adoption (:951-962) land in network order; if a pre-command PUT response lands after the read adopted the post-command row, baseVersion regresses and the next save meets 409 and the existing rollback (INFERENCE, not measured). (3) One read per committed event: a HirePilot batch (FundsChanged + PilotHired) reads twice; both reads see the one rewrite of that batch. (4) On a snapshot-authority campaign (every co-op campaign in production while the flag is false) the row does not move (campaignRecordJournalState.ts:80), the read returns the version the host holds, and a host whose cache key is at that version keeps its live, folded campaign (:931-940; guard row planned). A host whose cache key is NOT at that version - after a 409 rollback, which does not re-stamp the key (:730-756) - has the live campaign replaced by the stored record, which lacks the command's balance and day until the next frame re-projects the fold (INFERENCE, not measured at admission).
designAnswers.armedSave: For a co-op host markDirty never arms the debounced save (:1382-1384), so on this flow the refresh's clearAutoSaveTimer (:1341) cancels nothing unless an earlier failed refresh re-armed it; the refusal U35f removes is the host's next explicit save (useCampaignStore.actions.ts:259-264, 285-291; dayActions.ts:239) carrying the pre-command baseVersion.

pathAmendmentWhy: the fold reaches the action through useCampaignPersistenceStore.getState() (an import, no edit under src/stores/campaign), and the frame carries the only field the action reads (event.campaignId), so no server edit either
risksForTheParent: Authority: on a journal-native campaign the refresh replaces the host's live campaign with the server record and clears dirty (runLoad, useCampaignPersistenceStore.ts:941-962); a host-local change not yet saved when a co-op frame arrives is discarded, as the store's own comment says (:1305-1322). A co-op host's edits through updateCampaign and the day actions save at once (useCampaignStore.actions.ts:259-264, 285-291), so the window is a local change not routed through an explicit save; without U35f that change's next save would be refused 409 and rolled back on a journal-native campaign anyway.

Authority (production today): every co-op campaign is snapshot-authority while CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_ENABLED is false, and U35e does not rewrite its row (campaignRecordJournalState.ts:80). The refresh then reads the version the host already holds; a host whose cache key is at that version keeps its folded campaign (guard row s planned). A host whose cache key is stale - after a 409 rollback, which does not re-stamp the key (:730-756), or a read landing between the host's own PUT commit and its response - gets the stored record, which lacks the co-op command's balance and day until the next frame re-projects the fold; a save in that window writes the stale balance into the snapshot-authority record. INFERENCE, not measured at admission; this ends at the flip (U35d), after which every co-op campaign is journal-native.

Concurrency: the refresh and a save already in flight are not ordered (runSave awaits inFlightLoad only at its start, :790-792; runLoad does not wait on the save chain), so a pre-command PUT response landing after the refresh adopted the post-command row regresses baseVersion and the next save meets the existing 409 rollback and toast. INFERENCE. Fixing the ordering needs an edit under src/stores/campaign.
Concurrency: one read per committed event (a HirePilot batch of FundsChanged + PilotHired reads twice); responses processed out of order could adopt an older version (INFERENCE).
Owner ruling: the authority and concurrency classes need the head-bound Lane B ruling on the head that merges.
decision: go: --next printed U35f on the baseline, the validator passed, the fold reaches refreshAfterCommittedCommand through the store's public getState() with no edit under src/stores/campaign, and the committed frame carries the one field the action reads (event.campaignId) with no server change; estimated 1 product file and about 35 product lines

storeSeams.what: saveChain, the tail of the serialized write chain, and performSave, which queues each write behind it
runSave: awaits a published inFlightLoad only at its start (:790-792), PUTs at baseVersion, and applies a saved answer unconditionally (:815-818)
applySavedRecord: sets baseVersion, metadata, lastPersistedCampaign, fence and the cache key from the answer
rollbackCoopCampaign: adopts the server record, its version, metadata and fence, but never re-stamps the cache key (writeCachedCampaignKey, :415-418)
runLoad: keeps the live campaign only when the held cache key names the row it read (:920-940), else replaces it with the stored record (:941-949)
refreshAfterCommittedCommandAction: clears the timer, runs runLoad at once without waiting for a save in flight, and publishes itself as inFlightLoad (:1357-1364)
the actions table's comment says the refresh has no production caller; the U35f fold is one now

design.waitForSaveInFlight: refreshAfterCommittedCommand queues its read on the save chain (saveChain.then(runLoad)) and becomes the chain's tail, so a save in flight lands - version, cache key and all - before the row is read, and a save requested meanwhile runs after the read. It stops publishing itself as inFlightLoad: a save queued ahead of it awaits inFlightLoad when it starts while the read waits for that save, so publishing would deadlock the two; the chain already orders later saves behind it.
design.rollbackStampsCacheKey: rollbackCoopCampaign calls writeCachedCampaignKey on the server record it adopts, so the cache key names the record the live campaign now is.
design.lateSaveAnswerKeepsNewerVersion: runSave, on a saved answer for the campaign the store holds whose version is below the baseVersion the store already holds, leaves the adopted record's state as it is and only marks the save saved; the row can only have moved past this write by a write built on it. With the refresh on the chain the refresh cannot adopt ahead of a save's answer, so on the refresh path this is a guard; a load (runLoad through loadCampaign, which waits for no save) can, and that is the path its row drives.
design.comments: the refresh action's comment (publication, dirty callers), the actions table comment (a production caller now exists), and doc comments on runSave and rollbackCoopCampaign (both change)
design.notChanged: runLoad, the cache verdict, loadCampaign's own publication, the discard flush and reconcile paths, resolveConflictTakeServer (not a co-op rollback)
